title: 第7章 截胡剧情！
slug: 我在致郁番里画热血番
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

贺舟其实结合了书评，已经大概知道了原本的剧情是什么。

应该是饿了的女主战斗力下降了，结果遇到危险，恰好碰见主角之一的路安。

无聊又老套的剧情。

“你刚刚遇到妖魔了？”

“嗯！”

这个嗯尾音上扬，莫名有种田园猫去下边打了一圈架，打赢了回来求表扬的错觉。

“打赢了？”

“嗯！嗯！”

江黛吃一碗猫条拌三文鱼饭之后，舒服得眯着眼睛，摊在位置上四仰八叉的，不像一个美少女，倒像一只尾巴甩甩的猫。

“我不饿！赢了！”

“……”

贺舟这一下就清醒了过来，回过神来，大概明白了这个作者的剧情开展情况。

她应该并不能直接干涉漫画了，剧情应该还是以这边为主，而她的干涉似乎更像是植入一种意念的方式。

但是显然角色是能拒绝的。

如果是这样的话，那自己这边的操作空间就大得多了。

他看着莫名来了自己家的江黛，语气带着几丝试探：“那…今天太晚了，你回去也不安全，不如你睡沙发？”

这话一落音，人气疯狂上涨。

【角色人气值增加0.0002】

【角色人气值增加0.0002】

显然因为看到这里的漫画读者似乎多了许多，人气值一次增长的数量也增加了。

【怎么又是他？】

【我怎么感觉女主这只田园猫好像要被他开始喂熟了？】

【不可能，江黛据说是九命猫妖，可惜就是实力容易波动。】

【对，九命猫妖是一辈子只认一个主人的，现在顶多就是来蹭个饭而已，这个心机NPC天天喂猫条。】

九命猫妖？

这么厉害？

可一看到实力波动这四个字，贺舟就忍不住气笑了。

实力波动，战力不祥，解释权归作者所有是吧？

接下来半个月，贺舟沉浸在了这个漫画里。

教室里默默地又少了几个学生。

每天贺舟都用猫条和三文鱼猫饭把江黛喂得饱饱的，然后她一脸傲娇地一言不发地送他回家。

可这依旧让贺舟十分没安全感。

好几次的晚上，他都听到了附近的妖魔顺着怨气爬出来的淅淅索索的声音。

有了警觉耳之后，虽然能靠听声躲避一定的危险，但是自己依旧还没自保能力。

“到了高二，大家就会正式分班。”

“这一次分班之后，会给大家测试承载力，承载力越高，在凝结出灯池之后，觉醒的能力就越高。”

台上的班主任在讲着正式分班的事。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

He Zhou actually had a rough idea of what the original plot was based on the book reviews.

The heroine's combat effectiveness was reduced because she was hungry. As a result, she encountered danger and happened to meet Lu An, one of the protagonists.

Boring and cliche plot.

"Did you just meet a demon?"

"Yeah!"

The ending sound of this "um" is rising, giving the impression that the pastoral cat went downstairs to have a fight, and came back to seek praise after winning.

"Did you win?"

"Yeah! Yeah!"

After Jiang Dai ate a bowl of cat strips mixed with salmon rice, she was so comfortable that she squinted her eyes and stretched out in her position, looking less like a beautiful girl than a cat with its tail swaying.

"I'm not hungry! Win!"

"..."

He Zhou suddenly came to his senses, came back to his senses, and roughly understood the development of the author's plot.

She shouldn't be able to directly interfere in the comics. The plot should still focus on this aspect, and her interference seems more like a way of implanting an idea.

But obviously the character can say no.

If this is the case, then there will be much more room for maneuver on your side.

He looked at Jiang Dai who had come to his house inexplicably, and his tone was a little tentative: "Then...it's too late today, and it's not safe for you to go back. Why don't you sleep on the sofa?"

As soon as he said this, his popularity skyrocketed.

[Character popularity value increased by 0.0002]

[Character popularity value increased by 0.0002]

Obviously because there seem to be a lot more comics readers here, the number of people whose popularity has increased at one time has also increased.

[Why is it him again?】

[Why do I feel like the heroine’s pastoral cat is about to be fed to maturity by him?】

[Impossible, Jiang Dai is said to be a nine-life cat demon, but unfortunately her strength fluctuates easily.】

[Yes, the Nine-Life Cat Demon only recognizes one master in its entire life. Now it is just here for a meal. This scheming NPC feeds the cat every day.】

Nine-lived cat demon?

So powerful?

But as soon as he saw the words "strength fluctuation", He Zhou couldn't help but laugh angrily.

The strength fluctuates and the combat power is ominous. The right of interpretation belongs to the author, right?

In the next half month, He Zhou was immersed in this comic.

There were silently fewer students in the classroom.

Every day, He Zhou fed Jiang Dai well with cat strips and salmon cat rice, and then she sent him home with a proud look on her face without saying a word.

But this still made He Zhou very insecure.

Several times at night, he heard the sputtering sounds of nearby demons crawling out out of resentment.

After having alert ears, although I can avoid certain dangers by listening to sounds, I still have no ability to protect myself.

"In the second year of high school, everyone will be officially divided into classes."

"After this time, we will test everyone's carrying capacity. The higher the carrying capacity, the higher the ability to awaken after the light pool is condensed."

The head teacher on the stage was talking about the formal division of classes.
